paper_id: Guo et al. - 2021 - LEGO-Fi Transmitter-Transparent CTC With Cross-Demapping
title: LEGO-Fi: Transmitter-Transparent CTC With Cross-Demapping
motivation: Physical-level CTC需要发射端复杂处理,无法支持从低能力设备到高能力设备的通信,阻碍双向高吞吐CTC
problem_framing: 如何让标准WiFi模块复用接收ZigBee数据包,实现发射端透明的跨技术通信
key_insight: ZigBee包经过WiFi模块时留下可区分特征;WiFi丰富的处理能力可灵活处理ZigBee简单编码调制
method_signature: 跨解映射(cross-demapping):将CTC解码问题转化为模式识别问题,复用WiFi模块解码ZigBee符号
evaluation_criteria: 吞吐量(kb/s)、符号误码率(SER)、分组接收率(PRR)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 直接解码ZigBee信号在WiFi上不可行,需将解码问题转化为模式识别
evidence_for_taste: directly decoding a ZigBee signal on WiFi appears to be infeasible
we translate the ZigBee decoding problem into the pattern identification problem
the asymmetry in devices' capacity offers extra flexibility
unique protocol features also provide important basis
physical-level manipulation is more reliable than packet-level controls
thinking_moves: 将看似不可行的直接解码问题重新frame为模式识别问题
利用协议层的重复结构(前导码周期性)作为检测依据而非丢弃信号
复用现有WiFi模块(前导检测、符号同步、正交解调器)实现跨技术接收
通过动态时间规整(DTW)处理信道噪声和时序抖动带来的序列失配
